tasks.title: Account pages and confirmation errors render in the signed-in shell
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, Behavior (Required behavior 1-3) and D1; Checks 1 and the account portions of Check 5 (Layout, Viewer, No JavaScript, Axe, CSP, Focus order); Completion evidence (account documentation). Implement the shared account shell helper and move roleOfUser together with all four pure page parts and every route/re-render: 401, 422, 429, 409 expired and both credentials-changed paths. Reuse one SessionForm per rendered response, retain token path bindings and HEAD behavior, and use the request's current user on race responses. Add the two Cancel anchors and sessions back link, remove only the duplicate sessions sign-out form, and preserve the result page's Continue without Cancel. Extend existing race tests for the credentials-changed shell responses. Keep all Non-goals and the applicable Security impact rules. Add the associated HTTP and browser tests in this task; e-mail geometry, colours, gaps and 404 checks belong to T3, failure checks to T2. Update the account description in both documentation files.

acceptance.command: bun test src/server.sessions.test.ts src/server.recovery.test.ts src/server.security.test.ts src/server.form-token.test.ts src/server.races.test.ts src/server.account-token.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail; all selected tests pass (the focused run may miss the 0.8 coverage gate). Each full-session GET /account/security, /account/sessions, /account/sessions/sign-out-all and /account/recovery-codes answers 200 with exactly 1 doctype, h1, shell-header, Main nav and /console.js script. Titles remain Account security, Sessions, Sign out all other sessions and New recovery codes; the user, role and original account content remain. Overview links to / without aria-current. Both confirmations retain their shell and Cancel on every specified error response; Cancel is inside the primary button's actions group and targets /account/sessions or /account/security. Sessions has Back to account security and exactly 1 action="/sign-out". Viewer sees Overview and no Team. Enrol and factor receive 303 to /account/authenticator and /sign-in/factor with no shell. HEAD answers 200 with an empty body and 0 newly stored tokens; an earlier GET token is still accepted once. Header/page tokens are rejected at each other's paths; all existing replay, throttle, race, CSRF and security-header checks pass. The successful recovery-code result has 10 codes, Continue and no Cancel.
exit 0; existing lint rules pass without configuration changes
exit 0; source and e2e both type-check

exit 0; new ok: output names all four account routes and the wrong-password recovery confirmation at 390 and 1280 px: each fits, shows header and Main nav, has 1 h1 and reaches / through Overview. Viewer has Overview and no Team. With JavaScript disabled, sign-out-all Cancel returns to /account/sessions and the second browser still gets 200 with Signed in as; confirming then ends the other session. Recovery Cancel returns to /account/security with the same recovery-code count; confirming still shows 10 codes once and Continue reaches /account/security. Axe reports 0 violations on all four routes, CSP reports 0 violations and the existing Skip to content, Account security, Sign out, Overview focus order still passes.

tasks.title: Overview distinguishes refused connections, timeouts, network errors and HTTP status
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, Behavior (Required behavior 5), D2-D4; Checks 3-4 (failure rendering) and Check 5 (Failure kinds and api-refused fixture); failure Counterexamples; Completion evidence (failure documentation and D4 finding). Add refused classification, the kind-label function, fixed safe text and the Kind paragraph, with own data-property inspection at the permitted two levels and a generic fallback for accessors, inherited properties and throwing Proxies. Change overview-read.ts only if the first red test reproduces the false timeout or passing the error through requires it; preserve transport, precedence and exact log fields. Update the existing closed-port Overview assertion in server.security.test.ts while leaving that file's separate setup-connection assertion unchanged. Add api-refused to API_FAILURES, its HTTP fixture coverage and FIXTURE_PAGES. Browser failures must traverse /, readOverview and the real fetchJson using the specified refused fetch switch and injected deadline scheduler; reset every switch and prove recovery. Add all associated tests now and document the four failure kinds/texts in both docs. Record the D4 reproduction result for the final PR evidence. The 404 part of states.ts remains for T3; connection-test.ts and its tests stay unchanged.

tasks.title: The 404, links and mobile header match the shell and all console checks pass

Make the 404 body the fixed D6 sentence plus the existing Overview link. Update the two removed-target assertions in server.confirm.test.ts as well as the specified 404 tests, because those fixture responses also use notFoundState. Apply only the specified console.css rules and account-email span; update the literal signed-in HTML assertion in server.overview.test.ts alongside shell.test.ts. Extend the existing GET /console.css test in server.test.ts with the literal link/visited-colour and stacked-form rules, without deriving expectations from CONSOLE_CSS. Browser computed-style reads prove only unvisited colour; separately inspect CSSStyleRule selectors and colours in document.styleSheets to prove an explicit a:visited rule and reject conflicting visited colours, as specified by the revised Check 5. Add optional ownerEmail with its existing default; switch all e2e owner sign-ins, including no-script and --serve output, to demo-owner@example.com and support the second long-address environment. Use exactly "a".repeat(58) + "@example.com" and first assert length 70, then the complete parenthesized text and fit. Add these browser checks with the changes they test, then run the whole repository and browser checks, the production bun start smoke check, the applicable security checklist and the unchanged CI compose/deploy flow.
